method: Fresh processes under Callgrind. For each file compare identical startup prefixes ending immediately after its load, with the load executed versus stubbed. This avoids executing dependent forms after omitting a required provider. Inline's stub still loads macroexp, so its delta excludes macroexp. Macroexp is stubbed via an early provide, then the process stops after inline. Deltas include load-time allocation and collection, and are not assumed additive across later boot phases.

feature_parity.before: All nine featurep results are true. GNU byte-run is preloaded without providing a feature.
feature_parity.acceptance: test/standalone-boot-libraries-check.el passes on clean GNU Emacs 31.1, fails with 8 findings on the baseline NeLisp, and exercises demanded providers after checking clean-start feature parity.

sidecars.cold: Flat arena heap dump after prelude installation and nelisp--fx-register-prelude. Includes object and intern regions, relocation table, and the executable build-digest trailer. Existing code validates header, relocation bounds and build identity. Baseline startup only uses it with explicit --cold-load-from. Reference explicit-cold nil returns nil with no Lisp errors at 1,417,510,422 Ir; local image has 1199 compiled FX records.
sidecars.native_startup: Build-pinned lazy compiler/loader capability and bytecode source companion, authenticated by its SHA-256 on first compiler/loader demand. Normal nil startup does not open it. It is not the base heap image.
sidecars.c_core_image: tools/c-core-image.sh loads a bundle, prepares/collects its heap and calls nelisp--arena-dump-image-stream. It caches .flat images keyed by executable, .cold, bundle and tool hashes; serializes publication with flock; restores explicitly with --cold-load-from. It is an additional-bundle cache, not automatic base startup. Its existing image API can cover the base: an empty extension bundle built in 4.440 s (289898464 bytes), and its identity marker check restored in 0.165 s.

decision: Use the existing validated image format for ordinary boot; defer the six optional providers and embed their source for relocation. The external-load measurements total 3.64G Ir against 29.08G for all boot work, so source-read deferral alone does not address most of the measured work. Tighten S3 from provisional 14.5G to 2.0G based on the measured 1.42G image restore, rather than treating 50% as the final target.
